description:
Designed for both day rides and serious touring, the King of Mercia frame geometry has been designed to give a relaxed and comfortable feel to the ride, ideal for long rides in the hills, an around-the-world tour, or spins to the local cafe. Built for hard graft by our craftsmen in the heart of England the (former ‘Kingdom of Mercia’).

A classic touring bike, with heart shaped cut outs in the lugs done by hand, this trusty steed has been in our stable since the early 1950’s. Seventy years of fine tuning means its one of our most popular and iconic models. A very comfortable geometry allows for long hours in the saddle.

Made with Reynolds 725 double butted steel tubing, the bike comes with disc brakes as standard (rim brakes are also an option). Available as frame-only or fully assembled: choose one of our three assembly packages – or we can help you build up the assembly to your own specification. This model is often also set up as an urban bike (see Urban bike category) due to its comfort and rather pretty heart-shape cut-outs.
